title.narrative: Supporting the Economic Empowerment of Afghan Women through Education and Training in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan

description.narrative: The Action aims to promote the academic, economic and social empowerment of women in Afghanistan, a factor contributing to economic development, peace, and regional stability. The overall objective is to strengthen human capacity development in Afghanistan by increasing womens access to quality higher education and TVET through cooperation with Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.
